Canada Pension Plan Investment Board decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 1.83% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Canada Pension Plan Investment Board sold 193,669 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 10.37M shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.74 billion, down from 10.57M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Canada Pension Plan Investment Board who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $935.30 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.20% or $0.38 during the last trading session, reaching $190.29. About 28.43 million shares traded or 18.35% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since August 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Canada Pension Plan Investment Board, which manages about $59.34 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Steris Plc Shs Usd by 32,700 shares to 223,000 shares, valued at $20.82M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Tesla Inc Com (NASDAQ:TSLA) by 16,426 shares in the quarter, for a total of 33,571 shares, and has risen its stake in Fiat Chrysler Automobiles N Shs.
